nodes.description: IRegistry instance address stored by UsingRegistry; trusted external contract reference for addressOf/owner lookups.
Owner address of Ledger/AddressSet, set in constructor and enforced by the fromOwner modifier.
Ledger.total, running sum of tracked balances, updated in add() and subtract().
Ledger/AddressSet doubly linked list mapping (address => Entry) with HEAD at 0x0.
Bankrollable.ledger, the Ledger contract holding bankroller balances.
Bankrollable.bankroll, cached copy of ledger.total() used in bankrollAvailable().
Bankrollable.whitelist, AddressSet that gates addBankroll() participation.
Bankrollable.profitsSent, cumulative profits already transferred to Treasury.
VideoPoker.Settings struct (minBet, maxBet, curPayTableId, numPayTables, lastDayAdded).
VideoPoker.Vars struct with curId, totalWageredGwei, curUserId, totalWonGwei, totalCredits.
VideoPoker.games mapping (uint32 => Game) holding per-game state.
VideoPoker.credits mapping (address => uint) of withdrawable user credits.
Mapping address => uint32 user id cache used by _createNewGame().
Mapping uint32 => address reverse lookup of user ids.
Mapping (uint16 => uint16[12]) of pay tables; multiplied by bet to compute payouts.
Returns registry.owner(); used by fromOwner modifier.
Internal view forwarding to registry.addressOf(name) to resolve named contracts.
Resolves the admin address via addressOf('ADMIN'); basis of fromAdmin.
Resolves the ITreasury via addressOf('TREASURY'); basis of fromTreasury.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; gates Ledger.add and Ledger.subtract.
Owner-only increase of an address balance in the ledger with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only decrease/removal of an address balance with unchecked arithmetic.
Iterates the linked list counting entries.
Materializes arrays of addresses and balances from the linked list.
Owner-only insertion of an address into the doubly linked set.
Owner-only removal of an address from the set.
Payable entry point adding msg.value to the Ledger, gated by the whitelist.
Caps amount by collateral then forwards Ether to a caller-supplied callback function.
Sends excess profits to the Treasury using a low-level call.
Computes balance - (bankroll + collateral) as signed profit.
Computes withdrawable bankroll given balance, collateral and bankroll.
Abstract view overridden by inheritors to define the collateral floor.
Abstract view overridden by inheritors to define the whitelist admin.
Adds an address to the whitelist set; access restricted to whitelist owner.
Removes an address from the whitelist set; access restricted to whitelist owner.
Payable fallback allowing the contract to receive revenue.
Payable game creation from msg.value with min/max/bankroll validation.
Game creation funded by the caller's credits mapping.
Finalizes a prior game and re-bets its stake using credits.
Emits BetFailure and optionally refunds the bet to msg.sender via call.value.
Validates game ownership/state then stores the user's draw bitmap.
Validates game ownership/state then resolves the hand.
Computes the initial hand from blockhash and stores draws/dBlock.
Computes dHand, hand rank, payout and credits the winner.
Increases totalCredits/totalWonGwei and credits[user] with unchecked arithmetic.
Decrements credits and sends Ether to the user using an unrestricted low-level call.
Creates game id/user id and writes the Game struct with block.number.
Public withdrawal of credits through _uncreditUser.
Payable credit top-up for msg.sender.
Admin-only update of minBet, maxBet and current pay table id.
Admin-only, once-per-day addition of a new pay table using block.timestamp.
Validates and stores a new pay table, incrementing numPayTables.
Derives max bet from bankrollAvailable divided by two royal-flush payouts.
Returns the admin as whitelist owner.
Returns vars.totalCredits as the required collateral.
Returns a 5-card hand derived from a seeded hash.
Replaces selected cards of a hand with newly drawn cards.
Pure poker hand evaluator returning a HAND_* constant.
Derives distinct cards by iteratively re-hashing the seed.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, whitelist, credit and refund checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for the once-per-day pay table gate and events.
Low-level value call in removeBankroll to a caller-supplied function selector with unlimited gas.
Low-level value call forwarding profits to the registry-resolved Treasury.
Unrestricted value call paying out credits to the user after state updates.
Low-level value refund to msg.sender inside _betFailure.
Unchecked addition total += _amt in Ledger.add.
Unchecked subtraction of balances/total in Ledger.subtract.
Narrowing unchecked arithmetic vars.totalCredits + uint88(_amt) in _creditUser.
Payout multiplication payTables[id][rank] * uint(bet) in _finalize.
block.timestamp / 1 days controls settings.lastDayAdded and the pay table rate limit.
Requested withdrawal amount passed by the caller to removeBankroll.
Caller-supplied function name whose selector is invoked during withdrawal.
Balance above collateral, used to cap the withdrawal amount.
Recipient of the credit payout in _uncreditUser.
Requested payout amount in _uncreditUser.
Stake amount supplied by the caller to betWithCredits.
Computed payout amount in _finalize before crediting the user.
Expected blockhash supplied by the caller to _draw for randomness verification.
Amount to remove passed to Ledger.subtract.
Current entry balance in Ledger.subtract, bounding the deduction.
Bitmap of cards to draw supplied by the caller to draw()/_draw().
Newly allocated game id returned by _createNewGame.

edges.reason: addBankroll validates msg.sender against the whitelist set before accepting funds.
removeBankroll uses msg.sender as the bankroller whose ledger balance is withdrawn.
betWithCredits checks and decrements credits[msg.sender].
_createNewGame maps msg.sender to a persistent user id.
_betFailure refunds the failed bet directly to msg.sender via call.value.
Ledger.fromOwner requires msg.sender == owner before any balance mutation.
Ledger.add is reachable only through the fromOwner gate.
Ledger.subtract is reachable only through the fromOwner gate.
changeSettings is gated by the fromAdmin modifier comparing msg.sender.
addPayTable is gated by the fromAdmin modifier comparing msg.sender.
addToWhitelist requires msg.sender == getWhitelistOwner().
draw() requires the game's resolved user address to equal msg.sender.
finalize() requires the game's resolved user address to equal msg.sender.
cashOut credits msg.sender through _uncreditUser.
addCredits credits the paying msg.sender.
addPayTable derives the day bucket from block.timestamp for its rate limit.
block.timestamp feeds the once-per-day pay table gate.
_creditUser reads and writes vars.totalCredits/totalWonGwei with narrowing conversions.
bet reads settings.maxBet/minBet for stake validation.
curMaxBet reads settings.curPayTableId to index the pay table.
_finalize multiplies the pay table entry by the bet to compute the payout.
curMaxBet reads the royal-flush payout from the current pay table.
_createNewGame writes a new Game entry into the games mapping.
betWithCredits decrements credits[msg.sender] with unchecked arithmetic.
_uncreditUser reads and decrements the user's credits before paying out.
removeBankroll removes the amount from the Ledger before the payout call.
bankroll is refreshed from ledger.total() after each mutation.
addBankroll consults whitelist.size()/has() to gate participation.
fromOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner.
getOwner returns registry.owner(), which anchors the fromOwner modifier.
addressOf forwards to the registry to resolve named addresses.
getAdmin resolves the privileged admin address via addressOf('ADMIN').
The fromOwner modifier gates execution of Ledger.add.
The fromOwner modifier gates execution of Ledger.subtract.
removeBankroll performs a low-level value call with an arbitrary selector after ledger updates.
sendProfits forwards value with an unbounded low-level call.
_uncreditUser pays out with an unrestricted low-level call.
_betFailure issues a low-level refund call to msg.sender.
Ledger.add increases total and entry balance without overflow checks.
Ledger.subtract decreases total and entry balance without underflow checks.
_creditUser accumulates credits/totals with unchecked narrowing casts.
_finalize multiplies the pay table payout by the bet without overflow guards.
addPayTable relies on block.timestamp derived day buckets for its rate limit.
The arbitrary callback executes after bankroll is updated but before the event.
The callback can re-enter Ledger interactions while removeBankroll is mid-flight.
The attacker-controlled callback can recursively call removeBankroll.
A malicious Treasury callback can re-enter profit accounting.
The payout callback can re-enter cashOut/_uncreditUser paths touching credits.
The refund callback can re-enter bet() while the failure path is executing.
The requested amount is forwarded as the value of the callback call.
The caller-supplied function name determines the selector invoked by the callback.
_available caps the withdrawal amount inside removeBankroll.
_user is the recipient of the value call in _uncreditUser.
_amt determines the value sent by the payout call in _uncreditUser.
_bet is the stake validated and charged in betWithCredits.
_payout is the product of the pay table entry and the bet.
_hashCheck is compared with the stored blockhash to validate the initial hand.
_amt participates in the unchecked subtraction path of Ledger.subtract.
_maxAmt bounds the branch that deletes the entry in Ledger.subtract.
_draws determines which cards are replaced when the initial hand is resolved.
_curId is the newly incremented game id stored by _createNewGame.
bet creates the game through _createNewGame after validation.
bet routes all validation failures to _betFailure.
bet consults curMaxBet() before accepting the stake.
betWithCredits creates the game through _createNewGame.
betWithCredits routes failures to _betFailure.
betWithCredits consults curMaxBet() before charging credits.
betFromGame finalizes the prior game before re-betting.
betFromGame reuses the previous stake through betWithCredits.
draw delegates to _draw after validation.
finalize delegates to _finalize after validation.
_finalize credits the winner with the computed payout.
_finalize derives the hand via getHand when draws are zero.
_finalize draws replacement cards via drawToHand.
_finalize evaluates the final hand rank.
_draw derives the initial hand from the block hash seed.
addBankroll records the deposit through Ledger.add.
addBankroll checks whitelist membership before accepting funds.
removeBankroll reduces the ledger balance through Ledger.subtract.
sendProfits reads profits() before forwarding value.
changeSettings writes minBet/maxBet/curPayTableId after the admin check.
addPayTable validates and stores via _addPayTable.
_creditUser increases credits[user] after updating globals.
_uncreditUser decreases credits[user] before sending Ether.
_createNewGame caches msg.sender's user id.
_createNewGame stores the reverse user address mapping.
_createNewGame writes the new Game record.
_createNewGame bumps curId/totalWageredGwei in Vars.
cashOut delegates the payout to _uncreditUser.
addCredits delegates crediting to _creditUser.
VideoPoker implements Bankrollable.getCollateral via totalCredits.
VideoPoker implements Bankrollable.getWhitelistOwner via the admin.
getHand builds cards using getCardsFromHash.
drawToHand sources replacement cards from getCardsFromHash.
addToWhitelist mutates the AddressSet through its owner-only add().
removeFromWhitelist mutates the AddressSet through its owner-only remove().
bankrollAvailable subtracts the collateral obtained from getCollateral().
bankrollAvailable reads the cached bankroll value.
getCollateral returns vars.totalCredits as the collateral floor.
getWhitelistOwner resolves privileges through getAdmin().

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is the value carried by the unsafe low-level callback and is only meaningful inside removeBankroll's payout.
_callbackFn supplies the selector executed by the unsafe call, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
_available is a temporary cap computed inside removeBankroll and folds into that core function.
_user is the recipient of the unsafe value call in _uncreditUser.
_amt is the value forwarded by the unsafe payout call in _uncreditUser.
_bet is the caller-provided stake consumed only by betWithCredits validation and charging.
_payout is the result of the unsafe multiplication of pay table entry and bet.
_hashCheck is only used to compare against the stored block hash inside _draw.
_amt drives the unchecked subtraction performed by Ledger.subtract.
_maxAmt bounds the deletion branch of the unchecked subtraction in Ledger.subtract.
_draws selects the cards replaced during _draw and is local to that resolution step.
_curId is the incremented game id produced by _createNewGame.
